documentation_searches.question: Where is the 2015 'RTH Lookup List' that q2015 p. 5 names for CYAQRTH?
documentation_searches.scope: PSID/documentation (its only subdirectory is capture1): the text layers of all 494 PDFs (Poppler pdftotext -layout 26.09.0) and the HTML, JSON and text metadata files, searched line by line and again per page with whitespace collapsed across line breaks. Documentation only; no data file was searched.
patterns: printed three-digit relationship values 101, 201, 202 or 901 followed by a relationship word
documentation_searches.result: Absent. 'RTH Lookup' occurs only as references: q2009 p. 109, q2011 p. 105, q2013 pp. 5 and 115, q2015 pp. 5 and 131 (the line-by-line pass missed q2009, where the two words fall on two lines). Every other lookup hit is a state, country, city, address, school, car-model or telephone lookup, a family-member name lookup (MEMBERLOOKUP, q2021-q2025), a Child Development Supplement list or scoring table, or a passing use of 'look up'. The first instrument that prints the CYAQRTH values is q2017 p. 5; q2019 pp. 130-131, q2021 pp. 251-252 and q2023 pp. 249-250 follow. No staged document prints 201 as a relationship value before q2017. The printed-value pattern also matched the DUST 2009 and 2013 household codebooks (dust09_hh_codebook pp. 3 and 5; dust13_hh_codebook pp. 4 and 6), which list their files' relationship values without 201, and numeric cells of calibration tables in the 2011 to 2017 cross-sectional weight reports, which are not relationship values. In q2015 the token 201 occurs only as the page number of p. 201, and q2015 never names 901, while q2017 names 201 in routing conditions or question-text fills on 20 pages.
